headline.title: I Got a Free Meal From a Private Chef—Who Filmed It All to Train Robots
headline.summary: A German startup provided a free meal prepared by a camera-equipped private chef in exchange for recording the cooking process. The footage will be used to train robots in culinary skills.

articles.title: How enabling two settings tripled our scores on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark
articles.summary: Enabling two specific API settings significantly enhanced the performance of GPT-5.6 on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, tripling its scores. The adjustments focused on improving reasoning retention and enabling compaction, resulting in increased efficiency.

articles.title: We’re launching Lyria 3.5 in Google Flow Music, with advances across musicality, lyrics, vocals, and creative control
articles.summary: Google has launched Lyria 3.5 in its Flow Music platform, featuring enhancements in musicality, lyrics, vocals, and user creative control. The update aims to improve the overall music creation experience for users.

articles.title: Microsoft logs $3.2B from Anthropic investment, but OpenAI was a mixed bag
articles.summary: Microsoft reported a $3.2 billion gain from its investment in Anthropic, while its investment in OpenAI yielded mixed results, as detailed in the company's fourth-quarter earnings for fiscal 2026. The earnings report highlighted the contrasting performance of its investments in these leading AI labs.

articles.title: Mythos attack on 3rd-round PQC algorithm candidate puts it out of commission
articles.summary: The Mythos attack has successfully identified a critical vulnerability in the HAWK algorithm, a third-round candidate for post-quantum cryptography (PQC), rendering it inoperative. This discovery marks a significant setback for HAWK, which had previously undergone extensive testing without revealing such a flaw.

articles.title: Microsoft is openly competing with OpenAI, Anthropic more than ever
articles.summary: Microsoft has unveiled its own AI models and tools, positioning itself as a direct competitor to OpenAI and Anthropic. The company aims to leverage these developments for sustained growth, as communicated to Wall Street.

articles.title: Discover what’s next for AI, from the SaaS reckoning to the agent security gap, at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
articles.summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 will feature an AI Stage focused on key issues in the AI community, including the SaaS reckoning and agent security gaps. The event is presented by Google for Startups and aims to explore the future of AI developments.

articles.title: Eco3S: Complex Socio-Economic System Simulation via Agent-Based Models
articles.summary: The paper introduces Eco3S, a socio-economic system simulation framework designed to enhance economic research and policy analysis through agent-based modeling (ABM). It addresses challenges in current LLM-based ABM research, including agent-environment interactions, counterfactual reasoning, and automation of simulation workflows.

articles.title: Sim2Win: A Team-Agnostic, Event-Based Pre-Match Outcome Prediction and Tactical Profiling System for Football
articles.summary: The paper introduces Sim2Win, a team-agnostic framework designed for pre-match tactical decision-making in football, which utilizes event-based data to enhance outcome prediction. By leveraging StatsBomb open event data from multiple competitions, the system aims to provide a more objective approach to tactical profiling and decision support for teams.

articles.title: (EC)2: Event-Centric Explainability for Cybersecurity Through Multi-Agent LLM Investigations
articles.summary: The paper presents an event-centric, detector-agnostic approach to enhance explainability in cybersecurity alerts, addressing the limitations of feature-level explanations used in anomaly detection systems. By focusing on contextual relationships and actionable insights, this method aims to improve the effectiveness of security operations center investigations.

articles.title: FAS-R1: A Unified Multi-Task MLLM for Reasoning Face Anti-Spoofing
articles.summary: The article introduces FAS-R1, a unified multi-task multi-level learning model designed for face anti-spoofing (FAS) that enhances decision-making by providing attack semantics and image-grounded evidence. This model addresses limitations of existing FAS methods by moving beyond label-centric approaches and improving optimization for challenging spoofing attacks.

articles.title: LLMET: Enabling Cross-Layer Evaluation of Emerging M3D Memories for Energy-Efficient LLM Serving
articles.summary: The article introduces LLMET, a framework designed to evaluate emerging monolithic 3D (M3D) memory technologies for enhancing energy efficiency in Large Language Model (LLM) serving. It addresses the challenges of energy consumption and data movement between on-chip cache and off-chip High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) as LLM deployment scales.
